set.presentation: A 6-year-old girl referred by her school nurse feels well but is at the 10th percentile for weight and tires before her friends. Soft 2/6 systolic ejection murmur at the left upper sternal border, a low mid-diastolic rumble at the lower left border; S2 widely split, the same in both breathing phases.

A baby born at 27 weeks, now 10 days old on CPAP, needs more oxygen, has had two apneic spells and is not tolerating feeds. HR 168, BP 52/24 (58/36 on day 3); active precordium; a new 2/6 murmur below the left clavicle that carries on past S2; liver edge normal.
